findings.problem: Both zero values compare equal because only field equality is checked. The unusable zero Clock therefore reports an idempotent persisted attempt match.
findings.required: Reject invalid/zero clocks before comparison and test zero/zero, zero/valid, valid/zero and valid replay.
findings.evidence: Direct source evaluation of the all-zero operands; not a Go execution claim.

findings.problem: The constructor accepts any positive, representable operation window, while the SQL candidate additionally rejects windows below 60 seconds or above 86400 seconds.
findings.required: Use the original operation deadline contract consistently. If there is no original fixed operation-window bound, remove invented SQL limits rather than introducing a new policy; cover the constructor/persistence boundary cases.
findings.evidence: For example a one-microsecond window satisfies the constructor shape/arithmetic checks but not the SQL BETWEEN clause; no MySQL/Go execution claimed.

required_in_following_persistence_review: Compare the real resource-to-parent relation, not merely two independent existing FK targets. Use full guarded SQL/locked row checks or a composite parent-resource FK.
Bind the budget identity to the original parent immutable snapshot; decoded arbitrary canonical bytes are not ownership or operation authority.
Operation retries use the new original operation window while claim takeover reuses exactly the persisted old attempt; neither can revive deleted resources.
Include new ledger references in A owner and GC reference catalogs, metadata/schema/grant gates, catalog migration version and affected native/SQL obligations.
Maintain original shared transaction lock order and no new business locks or external I/O after the final validation/CAS layer.
positive_scope: Budget parser reuses the existing complete canonical ConfigValues decoder and verifies bytes/size/hash.
Automatic backup and first terminal drill timing branches are separated from explicit operation timing.
The draft explicitly distinguishes timing facts from provider/deletion authority and does not claim CAS/reader implementation.
